name: How long does a typical trim repair project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical trim repair project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a trim repair project varies based on the extent of damage, the type of trim, and the number of areas requiring attention. Minor repairs, like filling small holes or cracks, might take a few hours. More extensive projects involving multiple sections of rotted trim or complex molding profiles could span several days. Our team assesses each project individually to provide an accurate timeline. We prioritize efficient and thorough work to minimize disruption to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trim repair times vary from a few hours for minor fixes to several days for extensive damage, depending on the scope and complexity of the project.
